record.title: Unconsented Cross-Project Member Import Triggers _outside_member Lockout on Victim Project Account Management and Sign-In Code Issuance
record.description: A project_pi or project-scope data_manager in Project B can upload any existing active Project A user's email address or 10-digit mobile number to POST /admin/api/projects/<project_B>/users-grid/members/import with dry_run=0. Because prepare_members() and apply_members() in app/services/project_user_import_service.py:645-791 attach any matched active VaUsers account to MapProjectMember for Project B without checking whether the user already holds active grants, worker placements, or membership in another project, this unilaterally creates a MapProjectMember row in Project B. Downstream, _outside_member() in app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py:262-269 evaluates to True whenever any MapProjectMember row exists outside the caller's managed projects. Because _roster_rule() (app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py:155-194) and may_issue_code_from_data_management() (lines 293-312) enforce sa.not_(_outside_member(...)) across all non-admin callers even when the user holds active grants exclusively in Project A, Project A's project_pi and data_manager are immediately locked out of editing the user's profile (403 Forbidden on PATCH /admin/api/projects/<project_A>/users-grid/<user_id>/profile), sending password-reset links (403 Forbidden on POST /admin/api/projects/<project_A>/users-grid/<user_id>/password-reset), and issuing one-time sign-in codes from both the project roster (404 Not Found on POST /admin/api/projects/<project_A>/users-grid/<user_id>/sign-in-code) and the data-management panel (404 Not Found on POST /data-management/api/users/<user_id>/sign-in-code). Project A's managers cannot remove the MapProjectMember row in Project B to recover management of their own worker.
record.claimed_root_cause: prepare_members() and apply_members() in app/services/project_user_import_service.py:645-791 allow any project_pi or project-scope data_manager to attach any active existing VaUsers account to their project's MapProjectMember table by email or canonical 10-digit mobile number without verifying whether the account already belongs to or holds active grants/worker rows in another project, while _outside_member() in app/services/mobile_sign_in_service.py:262-269 treats any MapProjectMember row in an unmanaged project as disqualifying in _roster_rule() and may_issue_code_from_data_management() even when the target holds active grants only in the victim manager's project.

trace.description: Accepts multipart CSV/XLSX uploads at POST /admin/api/projects/<project_id>/users-grid/members/import from any admin, project_pi, or project-scope data_manager of an active organization-mode project (_guard(project_id, roster=True) at line 1765).

Matches uploaded email or 10-digit mobile rows against all VaUsers globally (lines 678-691) and marks any active existing user not yet in MapProjectMember for project_id as action='add_existing' (line 744) without checking existing memberships, grants, or workers in other projects.
Inserts MapProjectMember(project_id=project_id, user_id=user.user_id, added_by_user_id=actor_user_id) for every add_existing row when dry_run=0.
Returns True via SQL EXISTS when the target user has any MapProjectMember row with project_id outside the caller's managed project_ids.

Requires sa.not_(_outside_member(user_id_col, managed_projects)) for both grant-holding (rule_a) and unplaced (rule_b) roster users, causing issuable_user_ids (line 218) and editable_user_ids (line 248) / may_edit_account (line 256) to exclude the victim user for Project A's non-admin managers.

Rejects Project A's project_pi and data_manager with 403 Forbidden on profile edits (line 1640) and password-reset requests (line 1698), while sign-in code issuance is rejected with 404 Not Found on both the roster endpoint (line 1448) and data-management endpoint (app/routes/data_management.py:1020).

evidence.description: prepare_members() assigns action='add_existing' to any matched active VaUsers account not already in the caller's project MapProjectMember set, regardless of whether the user holds active grants, worker placements, or membership in another project.
apply_members() writes MapProjectMember(project_id=project_id, user_id=user.user_id, added_by_user_id=actor_user_id) without requiring target consent or checking cross-project affiliation.

_roster_rule() Conjoins sa.not_(_outside_member(user_id_col, managed_projects)) above sa.or_(rule_a, rule_b), so an unplaced MapProjectMember row in Project B overrides active grants held exclusively in Project A (rule_a).

may_issue_code_from_data_management() enforces not db.session.scalar(sa.select(_outside_or_signed_in(target_user_id, projects))), blocking Project A data managers from issuing sign-in codes on /data-management/api/users/<id>/sign-in-code once Project B adds a MapProjectMember row.

admin_project_user_panel_profile() and admin_project_user_panel_password_reset() (line 1698) return 403 Forbidden ('This account is shared with other projects; only an admin may change/reset it.') when may_edit_account() is False, and admin_project_users_grid_sign_in_code() (line 1448) returns 404 Not Found when may_issue_code_in_project() is False.

validation_plan.local: Inside an isolated test database, create two active organization-mode projects (PROJ_A and PROJ_B), a project_pi or project-scope data_manager in each project (dm_a, pi_b), and an active user (worker_a) with an active coder or interviewer grant in PROJ_A and mobile_login='9123456780'. Verify that dm_a initially receives 200 OK from PATCH /admin/api/projects/PROJ_A/users-grid/<worker_a_id>/profile and 200 OK from POST /admin/api/projects/PROJ_A/users-grid/<worker_a_id>/sign-in-code. Then authenticate as pi_b and POST a CSV 'name,email,phone\nWorker,,9123456780\n' with dry_run=0 to /admin/api/projects/PROJ_B/users-grid/members/import. Re-authenticate as dm_a and verify that PATCH /admin/api/projects/PROJ_A/users-grid/<worker_a_id>/profile and POST /admin/api/projects/PROJ_A/users-grid/<worker_a_id>/password-reset now return 403 Forbidden, and POST /admin/api/projects/PROJ_A/users-grid/<worker_a_id>/sign-in-code and POST /data-management/api/users/<worker_a_id>/sign-in-code return 404 Not Found.
validation_plan.deployment: Run the non-destructive pytest verification target in an isolated test database container without touching staging or production data: docker compose exec -T -e TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://minerva:minerva@minerva_db_service:5432/minerva_test_pii minerva_app_service uv run --no-sync python -m pytest tests/test_project_members_upload.py tests/test_roster_user_panel.py tests/test_roster_sign_in_codes.py -q -p no:cacheprovider.
